integrity: All evidence and limitations are stated without any claim of external certification or independent mathematical validation.
scientific_limitations: The theorem covers planar sections of the fixed regular cuboctahedron, not the general cube-crosspolytope interpolation. The full text of a relevant general maximal-section reference was unavailable and historical priority is provisional. The continuum proof is analytic; finite checks corroborate exact identities only.
title: Sharp affine-plane section area and directional balancing of the regular cuboctahedron
